sources.snippet: Local AI assistant for Linux. Opens apps, clicks buttons by name, types, searches the web, sees the screen and runs commands. 100% on your machine through Ollama, with its own trained model, Gargantua. - project-opentars/OpenTARS

sources.title: ProjectOpenTARS/Gargantua
sources.snippet: The official AI of openTARS, the 100% local assistant that controls your Linux desktop. Gargantua is a Qwen3 4B fine-tuned for one job: using openTARS tools the right way, on the first try.
